stem_book: An element has valence shell configuration ns² np⁴. Identify its period and group based on rules in the theory. (a) Period = n, Group = 14 (b) Period = n, Group = 16 (c) Period = n−1, Group = 6 (d) Period = n+1, Group = 15
work: period = outermost n; p-block group = 10 + (s+p electrons) = 10 + 6 = 16
